headings.usage: Use for level numbers, XP values, user stats, and main screen titles.

body.usage: Use for quest descriptions, UI labels, buttons, and navigation.

layout_and_spacing.container: w-full max-w-md mx-auto min-h-screen bg-[#050505] text-white pb-24
layout_and_spacing.notes: Use plenty of negative space. Do not cram elements. Containers with borders must have internal padding. Ensure a mobile-first responsive PWA style.

bottom_navigation.style: Fixed at bottom, floating above content. Glassmorphism effect. Pill-shaped container.
bottom_navigation.classes: fixed bottom-6 left-1/2 -translate-x-1/2 w-[calc(100%-3rem)] max-w-sm h-16 bg-[#0F0F13]/80 backdrop-blur-xl border border-white/10 rounded-full flex justify-around items-center px-2 z-50 shadow-[0_20px_40px_rgba(0,0,0,0.5)]
bottom_navigation.active_state: Text and icon colored in #00E5FF with a subtle drop shadow or background glow. Use framer-motion layoutId for active indicator pill.

buttons.primary: bg-[#00E5FF] text-black font-bold rounded-full px-6 py-3 hover:shadow-[0_0_20px_rgba(0,229,255,0.4)] transition-all hover:scale-105 active:scale-95
buttons.secondary: bg-transparent border border-[#39FF14] text-[#39FF14] font-bold rounded-full px-6 py-3 hover:bg-[#39FF14]/10 transition-all active:scale-95
buttons.icon: h-12 w-12 rounded-full bg-white/5 flex items-center justify-center hover:bg-white/10 border border-white/5

avatars.style: Hexagonal or perfectly round with a neon stroke.
avatars.classes: rounded-full ring-2 ring-[#00E5FF] ring-offset-2 ring-offset-[#050505] object-cover

progress_bars.fill: bg-gradient-to-r from-[#00E5FF] to-[#39FF14] h-full rounded-full relative

tags_badges.classes: px-3 py-1 rounded-full text-xs font-bold uppercase tracking-wider bg-white/5 border border-white/10 text-white flex items-center gap-2

icons_and_assets.sizing: w-6 h-6 for nav, w-5 h-5 for inline elements
icons_and_assets.stroke_width: 2.5 for a bolder, more game-like feel

animations.micro_interactions: Hover states on all cards (subtle lift and border color change to neon). Click/press scale down (active:scale-95).
animations.entrance: Staggered fade-up for dashboard widgets and leaderboard lists using framer-motion.
animations.glow_pulse: Pulse animation for active quest pins on the map.

accessibility.contrast: Ensure text over neon colors is dark (#050505) for readability. Muted text should be at least #A1A1AA against #0F0F13.
accessibility.test_ids: All interactive elements MUST have data-testid attributes.

Cyberpunk man avatar for rival player

badges.description: Glowing green 3d object used for a completed quest or unlocked badge icon

instructions_to_main_agent: Build a mobile-first PWA layout. The app wrapper should be limited to max-w-md and centered on desktop to mimic a phone screen.
Use framer-motion for smooth page transitions between the 4 main bottom nav tabs.
The Bottom Nav Bar MUST float above the content using fixed positioning and z-50. Ensure bottom padding (pb-24) on main content so it is not hidden.
Implement the 'Map' view with an interactive SVG or standard div-based map using panning/zooming. Plot interactive 'Quest Pins' that pulse.
XP and Level numbers must use the 'Unbounded' font to feel like a game UI. Ensure they are large and use the neon colors.
Use Shadcn UI components but heavily override their styles to match this dark neon aesthetic. Strip out standard gray borders.
Create a Quest Details Modal using Shadcn Dialog, styled with glassmorphism.
Include a dynamic gamification loop on the dashboard: a level progress ring, current XP, and a daily streak counter.
NEVER use generic placeholder text or empty avatars. Use the provided image URLs.
Ensure ALL interactive elements include descriptive data-testid attributes.
UNIVERSAL_GUIDELINES_FOR_MAIN_AGENT: Do not use dark colors as gradients. Dark colors look good when used independently.
Create depth through layered design elements with z-index hierarchy and soft neon shadows.
Use glass-morphism effects with backdrop filters (blur-xl) and subtle borders.
DO NOT apply universal transitions (transition: all) as it breaks transforms. Target specific properties.
DO NOT center align the app container text (no .App { text-align: center; }). Keep text left-aligned unless it's a specific metric.
Always use modern button styles (pill-shaped) with interaction animations.
NEVER use emoji characters for icons. Use lucide-react.
Use sonner for toast notifications (e.g., when a quest is completed or XP is earned).
